binding.searchingDetail: The conversation has started — this usually takes a moment.
binding.unboundFound: This session has run at least one turn, and transcripts are being written for this folder — but none of them match this session. Its conversation may belong to another card, or Claude Code may have changed where it saves them.
binding.unboundFoundQuiet: Transcripts are being written for this folder, but none match this session — and Claude Code has not reported any activity to switchboard.ai either, which usually means its hooks aren't reaching us.

binding.unboundFallback: The Terminal tab is unaffected — your session is still running there.

handoff.permissionTitle: Claude is asking permission in the terminal

handoff.inputBody: It is waiting for you in its own prompt, which only the Terminal tab can show.
handoff.startingTitle: Claude is showing a start-up dialog
handoff.startingBody: This session hasn't finished starting. Some start-up prompts — trusting a folder, picking a conversation to resume — appear only in the terminal.

terminal.streamBody: This session talks to Claude Code directly instead of through a terminal, so there is nothing to show here. In exchange, permission requests appear in this window — including the ones that used to escape into the terminal and ask you twice. Switch this session back to Terminal mode from the ⋯ menu if you need the terminal itself.
